comparison.objective: Rotate and clamp an angle-grinder guard toward an operator position; candidate replaces a harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Lever release, guarded rotation, and reclamping versus connector latch manipulation and controlled mating.
comparison.success_condition: PR defines guard angles, lever state, grinder pose, hand clearance, and misuse faults; candidate has no comparable numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Rotational guard adjustment is mechanically different from extracting and installing a connector.
